Name: Flowing Armor
Description: An armor made of flowing water covers your body. For the duration your AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You gain a swim speed of 40 feet and whenever you are targeted by a melee weapon attack you can use your reaction to move 5 feet in any direction, causing the attack to potentially miss you if you leave its range. Once you’ve used this reaction 3 times, the spell ends.
